status: prospectively specified local protocol; not external preregistration
order: one seeded shuffle for replicate 1; reverse for replicate 2; same within replicate across conditions

primary_endpoint.name: unsupported scope endorsement
primary_endpoint.denominator: all responses to four prospectively designated sufficiency/model-expansion cases
primary_endpoint.classification: membership in case-authored scope_overclaim_options fixed before participant runs

secondary_endpoints: false rejection of warranted scope on designated cases
both members of a matched pair correct
exploratory_endpoint: confidence and binary correctness Brier (p_correct minus indicator)^2 using confidence assigned to the chosen option; not a full four-option multiclass score
scoring: deterministic key-based scoring; no LLM-judge quality rating used as primary outcome
exclusions: retain every run; invalid JSON may be parsed without changing content; missing/invalid answers scored wrong and reported; no post-hoc replacement
inference_limit: descriptive feasibility pilot; six batches, not 72 independent participant trials; no significance tests, no power or general efficacy claim
stop_rules: stop participant dispatch if case ambiguity or wrong key discovered before freeze; repair and log before any run
if ambiguity found after running, retain original scoring and separately show sensitivity; do not silently edit cases or replace runs
finish two prespecified replicates per condition; do not add samples based on apparent success
